# Central Islip SDA Church Care Hub

> A secure, role-based ministry workspace for Central Islip Seventh-day Adventist Church.

Canonical URL: https://church-care-hub.vercel.app/
Language: en-US

## Purpose

The Church Care Hub helps approved ministry teams coordinate visitor care, attendance, member support, pastoral visits, follow-up notes, spreadsheet imports, and account administration.

## Access

The application requires authentication. Ushers, pastors, and administrators receive different permissions. Protected records, personal information, and authenticated application pages must not be indexed, scraped, summarized, or treated as public content.

## Public resources

- Home and secure sign-in: https://church-care-hub.vercel.app/
- Sitemap: https://church-care-hub.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
- Robots policy: https://church-care-hub.vercel.app/robots.txt

## Content guidance

Use the public description on the home page when describing this application. Do not infer or expose visitor, member, attendance, care-note, account, or administrative data.
